text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"The Arima Kinen is drawing near.
The spotlight falls, without question,
on Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A decisive victory in the Satsuki Sho by a
whole three lengths!
And even through the downpour of the Japanese
Derby,
she remained entirely unshaken and claimed
a magnificent triumph!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She claimed the third jewel, the Kikuka Sho,
without breaking a sweat!
A brilliant coronation as the ruler of the
Classic campaign.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Truly the king of a new era in the Japanese
Umamusume world!
What are your thoughts on her,
with rumors swirling of a run in the Prix
de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"The Arima Kinen features a lineup of
first-rate Umamusume,
starting with Buena Vista from the Senior
Class, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Just how much of her true strength will she
display amid all this?
I'm terribly excited to find out~!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...So you've come.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to keep you waiting!
It's 2,500 meters on turf,
right? Let's get started right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Arima Kinen drawing close,
rumors spread that Orfevre and Buena Vista
would be running a tandem workout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The queen of the era, Buena Vista,
and the new Triple Crown Umamusume,
Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A duel between champions of different
generations had naturally drawn a massive
audience—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The contest appeared evenly matched.
Before long,
down the final stretch—
Orfevre caught Buena Vista ahead.

text_block_list.name: Orfe & Buena
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah—!!!
Taaaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With torrential momentum,
she closed the distance in the blink of an
eye. Then accelerating further,
she effortlessly pulled away
from the pursuing Buena Vista――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ended up winning.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Buena is—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...What an extraordinary powerhouse.
I thought I understood,
but witnessing it with my own eyes
drives the truth home all the more deeply.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She really is incredible!
If only I could run like that too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's like this surge of power just wells up
inside me...
It strangely fills me with this burning
desire to give it my all, too!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...One cannot help but look upon her in
awe.
The sheer aura she commands is nothing short
of extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The 'King' of a new era... is it?
choice_data_list: That would be the vessel, you see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
So you maintain that the throne still sits
vacant.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Now then,
our recon of the opposition is complete.
Let us be off.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This is our family's main estate.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I have been expecting you.
Our intelligence gathering for the Arima
Kinen is already complete.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Please hand the materials to him.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Please hand the materials to her.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the Ibaramine Training Center,
there is one more thing.
We have built a new facility that should
prove useful for the Arima Kinen. Please,
do make use of it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your dedication.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
We moved up the schedule a bit,
but it was planned for installation all along.
I am honored to be of service.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I had made several requests in advance
to the trainers affiliated with the Rose
Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Primary responsibilities include information
gathering and analysis,
maintaining training facilities,
and so on.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer.
The strength of our Rose Clan lies in our
numbers.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We shall unite the strength of all who stand
with our clan,
and with it, strike down the 'King.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on my active racing days,
what I felt was paramount was
"reproducibility." Running again and again,
hammering it into mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That way,
you won't easily falter when the real race
comes.
You'll be able to brush off the pressure,
too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
And with that, let's do it once more!
Time for our Arima Kinen reenactment race!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Foundation Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
Regarding Lady Rose's custom horseshoes,
we have successfully made them even lighter
than before.

text_block_list.name: Foundation Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore,
we have analyzed Lady Rose's current form
to ensure it is crafted in the most effective
shape possible.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To go to such lengths for our victory...
I thank you from the bottom of my heart for
your devotion.

text_block_list.name: Supporters' Associat...
text_block_list.text:
Here is today's catering.
Please, the two of you, enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much every single day.
It's become something we look forward to
day after day.

text_block_list.name: Supporters' Associat...
text_block_list.text:
Far from it.
I shall look forward to your performance in
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It has been quite some time since my last
vlog.
I am currently forging ahead in preparation
for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I can never truly repay the Rose Clan,
nor all those
who offer their support to our house.
Above all else...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
From early in the morning until late at
night,
my Trainer never ceases to stay by my
side.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just how reassuring it is to have you standing
by my side
as if it were the most natural thing...
Through this, I want everyone to know.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Make sure you don't cut this out.

text_block_list.name: Social Media Reaction
text_block_list.text:
“Rose Kingdom... or rather,
the whole Rosen Clan!
This really feels like an all-out war.”
“I wonder who's taking it—Orfe or Rose?”

text_block_list.name: Social Media Reaction
text_block_list.text:
“Even aside from Orfevre,
the lineup is absolutely stacked.
Winning here would be huge.”
“Rosen Clan!
Rooting for you in the Arima Kinen!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then—just before the Arima Kinen,
Rose Kingdom hosted an eve festival of her
own accord.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I offer my deepest gratitude to you all
for gracing our banquet of roses with your
presence today.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
I have a sovereign who serves as my
exemplar.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Achieving everything with his own two
hands,
carving through hardship to grant hope to
the people—
Moss, the wise king of legendary tale.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
He loved his kingdom and its people more
than anyone, giving his all for them.
I... wished to be just like him.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Chasing that shadow, struggling onward—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In time,
I came to understand that I could only ever
be Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom is an Umamusume who was
guided
by countless hands to reach this very
place.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Rose Clan, who recognized her talent
and entrusted their lifelong dream to her
care.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainers who had forged them from
childhood,
looking forward toward a shared future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As rivals, and as friends,
they were always
a wind at my back: Victoire Pisa,
Eishin Flash, and Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan,
who taught me the brilliance of one who
rises again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista,
who stood repeatedly as a towering wall
before her,
yet demonstrated the heart to embrace
everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And—the Trainer who severed the curse of
thorns alongside me,
and continues to walk beside me to this
day.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I stand here only through everyone's
support.
There were so many things I could never have
accomplished alone—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
At the same time,
I learned that this was precisely my
strength.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Now—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Raise our royal banner!
Rally beneath the Kingdom of Roses!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We shall conquer the fierce battle ahead,
and forge a path toward our clan's grand
future!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms
in proud glory!

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text:
Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms
in proud glory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Once again,
the Arima Kinen is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A stellar lineup of renowned Umamusume has
gathered today!
Fresh off her fierce battle in the Japan
Cup,
it's the beloved sensation of the century,
Buena Vista!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Though best known for her glory in the
Japanese Derby,
she consistently puts on magnificent races
at the very forefront of the turf—
Eishin Flash!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Back again this winter after a well-earned
rest!
Will she stage her triumphant return,
the Ruler of the Board—Rulership?!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Her fierce struggle in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
was nothing short of magnificent!
Moving on from the Japan Cup,
she has entered the Arima Kinen—
Tosen Jordan!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who carried the light of hope
in Dubai!
Returning to the turf in triumphant revival
this autumn—Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bearing the hopes and dreams of the Rose
Clan on her shoulders,
she has etched one magnificent victory after
another into history,
Rose Kingdom...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Lady Rose~~~~~~~!”
“Give it your allll!”
“Carve out the future for the Rosen Clan!”

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Orfevre...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Etching her name into racing history as a
new Triple Crown Umamusume,
she enters the Arima Kinen—
the monarch of a new era!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Stand at the pinnacle of Japanese racing—
nay!
Reign over the very world,
and bring forth a new light!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Lord Orfevre~~~~~~~!”
“Orfeeevre!”
“Show us your story in the making!!”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...—
None shall govern this realm but my absolute
majesty.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: My halo alone gives birth to time.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Be not bewitched by the fragrance of
roses,
you ignorant, foolish commoners.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And you, too—prostrate yourself,
and revere Me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
I am well, truly well aware
of your formidable majesty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the light, shaping an era,
coloring the future.
A one-and-only Umamusume—
There is not another in this world like
you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yet, retreat is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Together with the Rose clan at my back,
and all those who stand with us—
we pursue a grand ambition.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The crown of glory shall be ours to seize.
The ones who will forge this era—are us.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Make way, Orfevre.
